beforeQuit.body: Made-up message 1: wait for made-up PRs A, B and C, with a made-up cutoff at noon. At the cutoff, take whatever is done; anything not done moves to the next made-up batch. PR C matters most, so review it before PR B if they compete for a reviewer. Do not take PR A alone. Same method as before, and tell me ten minutes before you start.

Made-up message 2: the earlier batch plan is accepted, and it replaces the noon cutoff. The next made-up batch goes as soon as PR C is done. One fix: take every timestamp in made-up status notes from the clock, never from an estimate, and correct the wrong lines in the made-up status notes.

afterRelaunch.body:
Made-up message 3: the app relaunched. Run the made-up checks for the done items, mark the ones that pass, then resume the parked made-up workers.

Made-up check-in. For each made-up feature and each made-up ticket: where it is, what runs now, what is blocked. Then send one short made-up status message.

Made-up facts:
- The made-up relaunch finished at a made-up time.
- No made-up check is recorded yet.
